sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your prompt response and the proposal for a 24-month contract, which provides valuable stability for both of our companies. In recognition of this longer commitment, we are prepared to adjust our price to €51.30 per unit.

For our longstanding partnership, our offer stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

It is always a pleasure to work together with your esteemed company, and we look forward to continuing our tradition of shared success.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
